fields.label: Template HTML
Preview Info
fields.options:
Available Template Variables:
  • doc - Student document with fields: student, student_name, program, academic_year, academic_term, attendance, etc.
  • assessment_result - List of assessment results with: student, student_name, course, assessment_group, total_score, grade, levels, percentage
  • courses - List of course names
  • assessment_groups - List of assessment group names
  • letterhead - Letter head HTML content
  • averages - Dict with opener, mid_term, end_term averages (each has score, grade, levels)
  • class_teacher - Class teacher name
  • student_image - URL to student photo
  • rubber_stamp - URL to school rubber stamp image
  • date - Current date/time
  • show_opener, show_midterm, show_endterm - Boolean flags for which exams to show
Example Usage:
{{ doc.student_name }}
{% for result in assessment_result %}
  {{ result.course }}: {{ result.total_score }}
{% endfor %}
